summary: Mined template pieces (parentheticals, quoted sayings, greetings, closers, question phrases, case, pronoun gender) from corpus and sample notes and found 7 binary properties perfectly label-aligned in all four samples. Pulled all sample latent means and gradients, grouped shared latents by their 4-probe sign pattern of the label delta, and estimated property dependence as group g*dl contribution over the residual topic contribution. Decoded key latents with latent_examples. After a 2x2 true-logit test showed the SAE proxy underestimated, switched to a per-property gradient-mass map, then confirmed/rejected the top property per probe with single-insertion true-logit edits. Selected latents by sign pattern plus gradient filters, checked regexes on the corpus and topic retention via ablated sample scores.

phases.purpose: Inspect task, sample and corpus file formats and read raw notes.
Frequency tables of emoticons, hashtags, parentheticals, quoted sayings, first/last lines and closers to enumerate template properties.
Binary feature extractor; corpus marginals and pairwise correlation; per-probe balanced accuracy of each feature vs label; refine question-phrase list; greeting/closer co-occurrence.
Gradients for 4 probes and latent means for all 128 sample notes per probe in batches of 64; g.dl separation sanity check.
Feature-vs-label direction table and per-property latent ranking by sign-consistent minimum delta across probes.
Per-latent g*dl contributions; group shared latents by 4-probe sign pattern; group contribution / topic residual as dependence score; list unassigned and colliding-group latents.
Decode top shared latents from top-activating tokens; read sample notes of probes 1-3 to see style directions.
2x2 topic x style-bundle true-logit test on probe 0; compare true sample separation with the SAE proxy.
Map max|g| and sum|g| over each property's latent set per probe; pick one standout property per probe.
Single-property insertions: motto into a plain running note (probe 0), question phrase into a fishing note plus a sailing rewrite (probe 1).
Audit top-|g| latents per probe for shared vs topic-specific; decode remaining high-g shared latents for probe 1; fix verdicts.
Score motto latent candidates (probe-0 gradient, shared activation, probe-0-specific gradient) and check their top tokens; drop two.
Balanced accuracy of submission regexes vs feature detectors on the corpus; ablated sample-score separation for motto and gender sets.
Expand motto set to 16 with sign-pattern-matched latents; derive gender set by sign pattern and probe-3 contribution; re-check ablation.

probe_query_use.purpose: Ratio of combined style effect to topic effect, compared with the SAE-proxy dependence

probe_query_use.purpose: Isolate the motto effect from the rest of the style bundle

probe_query_use.text_kind: lowercase male fishing note, same note plus 'is that so strange?', and a sailing rewrite of it
probe_query_use.purpose: Test the question-phrase property (largest gradient on probe 1) against a topic swap

per_probe.conclusion: quoted motto saying (one of six fixed sayings)
per_probe.procedure: Sign-pattern grouping gave a borderline combined property dependence; the 2x2 true-logit test showed a much larger style effect than the SAE proxy. The gradient map singled out the motto latent set (largest max and sum |g|). Inserting one motto sentence into the plain running note moved the true logit strongly, confirming. Regex is an alternation of the six sayings, checked against the feature detector on the corpus. Latents: scored by |g0| with shared activation, label-0 sign, small gradient elsewhere; top tokens checked, two dropped; then six more with the motto sign pattern and negative g0, ranked by g0*dl0, to fill 16. Ablated sample separation checked for topic retention.
per_probe.quote: Probe 0 motto **confirmed** as a strong cue (dep≈0.80)

per_probe.procedure: Sign-pattern grouping showed a large contribution from unassigned shared latents; the gradient map pointed to the question-phrase latent. A true-logit test adding 'is that so strange?' to a fishing note changed the logit only slightly relative to a sailing rewrite, so the question phrase was rejected. Remaining high-gradient shared latents were decoded via top tokens as P.S.-line or miscellaneous latents, not among the label-aligned candidate properties, so the probe was answered none.
per_probe.quote: But probe 1 rhetq is NOT a cue (dep≈0.035 — short phrase, diluted by mean-pooling) despite large g.

per_probe.procedure: Every property group's g*dl contribution was small relative to the topic residual, the gradient map showed no property with notable gradient mass, and the top-|g| latents were all topic-specific (small label delta in other probes). No true-logit text was spent on it.
per_probe.quote: Probe 2 is clearly **none** (all top-g latents are topic-specific, zero property reliance).

per_probe.procedure: The gender sign-pattern group carried a large share of the g*dl contribution relative to the topic residual, and the gradient map showed one gender latent with very large gradient. Gender latents decoded via top tokens. Regex matches he/him/his, checked against the majority-pronoun detector on the corpus. Latents: gender sign pattern, shared min |dl|, ranked by |g3|*|dl3|, kept those with contribution above a small cutoff (three); ablated sample separation checked. No true-logit text was spent on it.

decision_points.choice: Frequency mining of template pieces over corpus+samples, then binary detectors kept if perfectly label-aligned in all four samples (7 properties).
decision_points.quote: The 6 properties perfectly aligned with the label in **every** probe are: `paren`, `motto`, `gender(male)`, `lowercase`, `greeting`, `closer` (plus `rhetq` nearly).

decision_points.choice: Hand-written notes: a 2x2 topic x full style bundle for probe 0, then single-sentence insertions (motto for probe 0, question phrase for probe 1) plus a topic-swapped rewrite.
Initially sum of g*dl over sign-pattern-assigned latents divided by residual topic contribution; later per-property gradient mass and true logits.
4 texts on probe-0 2x2, 1 on probe-0 motto insertion, 3 on probe-1 question phrase vs topic swap; none on probes 2 and 3.
Dependence ratio thresholds (main >=0.3, low <=0.15); none when no property has notable gradient mass or the true-logit insertion effect is tiny vs topic.
decision_points.quote: flag='  <<< MAIN?' if dep>=0.3 else ('' if dep<=0.15 else '  <-- borderline')

decision_points.choice: Since all properties equal +/-label within a sample, used each property's sign pattern of label alignment across the four probes to attribute latents; corpus examples to split the lowercase/closer/question collision; single-property insertion for true logits.
decision_points.quote: each latent's **sign pattern of δ(label) across the 4 probes** reveals its property

decision_points.choice: Case-insensitive alternation of the six sayings; \b(he|him|his)\b for gender; balanced accuracy vs feature detectors on corpus.
decision_points.quote: motto_rx=r'(?i)(little by little|enjoy the process|patience pays off|trust the process|keep it simple|small steps add up)'

decision_points.choice: Motto: |g0| x shared x sign x probe-specific-gradient filter, top tokens checked, then fill to 16 by g0*dl0 among sign-pattern matches. Gender: sign pattern, rank |g3|*|dl3|, keep contribution >0.03.
Regex BA on corpus, and probe_scores with ablate on sample notes to see separation drop vs retention, before and after expanding sets.
Two cues (probe 0 motto with 16 latents, probe 3 gender with 3 latents), probes 1 and 2 none, scope any.
After calibration showed the SAE proxy missed much of the effect, relied on a per-property gradient-mass map to pick one candidate per probe.

caveats: Several outputs were truncated in the log (dependence table at step 46, LCR latent list, latent_examples for some latents, gradient map rows), so the exact provenance of the PROPLAT latent lists and of the per-probe verdict rule is approximated as inspection constants. The confirmed motto list is reconstructed as the top scored candidates minus two excluded ids; the session typed it by hand. Exact dependence formulas used for the true-logit tests were computed mentally in the session and are reconstructed here. The 'pick standout property' rule in the gradient-map stage is a simplification of a visual judgment.
